title: Art By Committee: Roasted
content: Wednesday is our day to have some fun with sketching game called "Art By Committee." The challenge is to illustrate an actual quote from a science fiction novel.This week’s quote about a narrow escape from being roasted called to mind all sorts of images, from marshmallows to dragons. Each one has its own flair and shows how differently our imaginations work.Roberta BairdRobert BrownTopher SipesMichael GeisslerAndy WalesKristina CarrollRyan TimmJared ShearJohn Randall YorkSusan AdsettArthur KeeganAiran WrightRob HummerAndrew WalkerPaul Bozzo…and the sketch by Jeanette, me, and a couple friends.I wonder what strange and wonderful stories lurk beneath the surface of next week's quote: “The man looked bored.”Please scale your JPG to around 700 pixels across. Title it with your name, send it to: jgurneyart(at)yahoo.com, subject line ABC, and let me know in your email if you want me to link to your blog or website. Please have your entries in by next Tuesday at 10:00 AM Eastern Time USA.
